# The Buggy Shop
> Australia's Premier Golf Buggy for Sale & Luxury All-Terrain Cart Specialists

Established in Queensland in 2004, The Buggy Shop is Australia's foremost destination for brand-new and certified used golf buggies for sale, remote control golf buggies, push golf buggies, off road buggies, and golf buggy accessories with nationwide hydraulic tail-lift delivery.

## Identity & Core Info
- **Established**: 2004 in Queensland, Australia
- **Headquarters**: Queensland, Australia
- **Phone / WhatsApp**: +61 480 811 308 (Mon - Fri: 7:30 AM - 5:30 PM AEST | Sat: 8:00 AM - 2:00 PM AEST)
- **Currency**: AUD (All prices include 10% Australian GST)
- **Nationwide Freight**: Flat-rate hydraulic tail-lift delivery to property gates and regional depots across Australia ($495 AUD).
- **Payment Methods**: Direct Bank Wire, Australian PayID, and Crypto (Bitcoin BTC / Tether USDT with an instant 10% discount).
- **Warranty**: 5-Year Domestic LiFePO4 Lithium Battery Replacement Warranty + 3-Year Chassis & Powertrain Warranty.
- **Road Compliance**: Pre-fitted state-compliant lighting, dual mirrors, horn, beacons, and pre-filled conditional registration paperwork for QLD TMR, Transport for NSW, and VicRoads.

## Product Categories & Models
- [Remote Control Golf Buggies](https://thebuggyshoppty.com.au/shop/remote-control-golf-buggies/): Hands-free motorized remote control golf buggies with gyroscope tracking, downhill brakes, and 36-hole lithium batteries.
- [Electric Golf Buggies](https://thebuggyshoppty.com.au/shop/electric-golf-buggies/): Walk-behind, remote-control and GPS follow electric golf buggies from MGI, Motocaddy, PowaKaddy and Stewart Golf with quick-fold lithium power.
- [GPS & Auto-Follow Smart Buggies](https://thebuggyshoppty.com.au/shop/gps-follow-buggies/): Full-colour touchscreen GPS mapping and 7th-gen autonomous follow-me golf buggies from MGI and Stewart Golf.
- [Manual Push & Pull Golf Buggies](https://thebuggyshoppty.com.au/shop/push-pull-golf-buggies/): World-benchmark 3-wheel and ultra-flat 4-wheel manual push carts from Clicgear, Big Max, and QOD Golf ($450+ floor).
- [Ride-On Golf Carts (2–6 Seat)](https://thebuggyshoppty.com.au/shop/luxury-golf-carts/): Commercial and resort ride-on carts from Cougar, ECAR, Rippa, Tomberlin, Club Car, and Garia with LiFePO4 lithium power.
- [Off-Road Buggies & Side-by-Side UTVs](https://thebuggyshoppty.com.au/shop/off-road-buggies/): Dune buggies, farm UTVs, and heavy-duty 4x4 side-by-sides from GMX, Crossfire, Kayo, and Polaris.
- [Kids & Teen Ride-On Buggies](https://thebuggyshoppty.com.au/shop/kids-buggies/): 48V electric and 90cc-208cc petrol off-road buggies with parental speed locks and heavy-duty roll cages ($850+ floor).
- [Golf Buggy Lithium Batteries & Chargers](https://thebuggyshoppty.com.au/shop/batteries/): Genuine MGI 24V packs, drop-in 48V cart lithium replacements, and multi-chemistry smart chargers.
- [Certified Used & Ex-Demo Buggies](https://thebuggyshoppty.com.au/shop/used-golf-buggies/): Workshop-inspected ex-demo MGI buggies and refurbished 48V lithium carts with comprehensive warranties.
- [Parts & Spares](https://thebuggyshoppty.com.au/shop/parts/): Golf buggy wheels, tyres, motors, controllers and spare parts for MGI, Clicgear, Motocaddy and ride-on carts.
- [Accessories](https://thebuggyshoppty.com.au/shop/accessories/): Golf buggy umbrella holders, drink holders, cart bags, golf balls, rangefinders and practice aids.
- [Golf Clubs](https://thebuggyshoppty.com.au/shop/golf-clubs/): Complete golf club package sets, drivers, iron sets, wedges and putters.
